question: Which 5 products earn the most revenue?
referenceSql: SELECT TOP 5 p.ProductName, SUM(ol.Quantity * ol.UnitPrice * (1 - ol.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol JOIN dbo.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = ol.ProductId GROUP BY p.ProductName ORDER BY SUM(ol.Quantity * ol.UnitPrice * (1 - ol.Discount)) DESC, p.ProductName
